name: Coral Senate
subtitle: Token-weighted DAO
description: Example 11 — hash-committed proposals, EIP-712 EOA/ERC-1271 weighted votes or direct account votes, and quorum-checked execution behind a timelock window.
long_description: Minimal governance for a token-weighted community. Proposals commit only the keccak256 hash of the action to execute; execution re-derives and matches the hash. OpenZeppelin SignatureChecker verifies EOA signatures or calls a code-bearing voter's ERC-1271 isValidSignature, including EastSea v2 P-256 accounts. EIP-712 v2 binds the current chainId, DAO address, proposalId nonce, action hash, voting end and execution expiry. A relayer submits sorted unique voter addresses paired with signatures. A wallet without off-chain message signing calls vote before voting ends and supplies an empty signature at execution; direct and signed votes can be mixed without double counting. Weight remains balanceOf at execution time. A timelock delays execution, and expired or executed proposals cannot execute. Proposals cost two state slots; off-chain votes add no state, while direct votes add one slot per voter and proposal. Executions reuse the proposal's existing packed slot.

ko.name: 코랄 센에이트
ko.subtitle: 토큰 가중 DAO
ko.description: 예제 11 — 해시 커밋 제안, EIP-712 EOA/ERC-1271 가중 서명 또는 계정 직접 vote, 타임락 뒤 쿼럼 실행. 서명 투표는 상태 0, 직접 투표는 유권자·제안당 1슬롯이다.

x-eastsea-template.summary: Token-weighted proposals with a voting period, timelock and grace period.

constructor.name: name_
constructor.label: Token name
constructor.description: Human-readable name of the ERC-20 token.

constructor.name: symbol_
constructor.label: Token symbol
constructor.description: Short ticker symbol of the ERC-20 token.

constructor.name: supply
constructor.label: Total supply
constructor.description: Total token amount in base units (18 decimals), minted once to the recipient; no further minting exists.

constructor.name: recipient
constructor.label: Initial recipient
constructor.description: Address that receives the entire supply at deployment; must not be the zero address.

constructor.name: guardian
constructor.label: Guardian address
constructor.description: Address allowed to engage the brake that blocks new proposals and votes.

constructor.name: votesToken_
constructor.label: Voting token
constructor.description: ERC-20 token whose holder balances give voting weight; must be a contract and not fee-on-transfer.

constructor.name: quorum_
constructor.label: Quorum amount
constructor.description: Total voting-token weight of approving voters required to execute a proposal; above zero.

constructor.name: votingPeriod_
constructor.label: Voting seconds
constructor.description: Seconds a proposal stays open for votes after it is created; above zero.

constructor.name: timelockDelay_
constructor.label: Timelock seconds
constructor.description: Seconds to wait after voting ends before a proposal can be executed; above zero.

constructor.name: gracePeriod_
constructor.label: Grace seconds
constructor.description: Seconds after the timelock during which a proposal can be executed before it expires; above zero.
